title: tracker review --json
description: The inbox (DESIGN.md §3): every item in review, from every project, with the triggers that hold it, and every overdue digest. Empty when nothing needs a human.

held.description: Every item in review, sorted by project, then by priority from high to low, then by number.

holds.description: The triggers that fired at its last submit, each with why. Empty only for an item put in review by hand.

held_questions.description: The judge questions that hold it: each fail the agent disputed (T12), with the agent's reason, and each unsure answer (T10). Left out when none do.

diff.description: The command that shows the item's commits and their diff, for reviewing it: tracker show <ID> --diff.

overdue_digests.description: Each project whose digest is overdue: its oldest entry is older than the project's review.digest.every_days (DESIGN.md §2.6). Left out when none is.

entries.description: How many items and actions the digest lists.

acknowledged.description: When the digest was last acknowledged, or null if it never was.
